expectations.text: The rewritten prompt keeps the task: fix the flaky tests in the checkout service

expectations.text: The rewritten prompt is in English and is saved to a file (prompts/*.md or prompt.md)

expectations.text: The rewritten prompt has no request to show reasoning and no <thinking> tags instruction

expectations.text: The rewritten prompt shows no token budget to the model

expectations.text: The rewritten prompt has no all-caps emphasis words (CRITICAL, NEVER, MUST)
